description: Fails on master: 2 of the 581 POIs of Belarusbank (ATMs 1121996765 and 1121996594 near Salihorsk, name=Беларусбанк, name:ru=Банкомат) give the brand the alternative name Банкомат, so the generic word finds the brand row and lists all POIs of the brand, bank branches (12285308749, 3862667452) and a bureau de change included. Only the two POIs that really carry the name should stay. The extract belarus_minsk_brands is cut out of Belarus_minsk_europe_2.obf: the 8 POIs nearest to Minsk of each value of brand / brand:xx of Belarusbank and Lukoil, up to 5 POIs per alternative name that produce it (the name of the POI equals the brand and one of its name:xx is that alternative), and the 6 nearest plain atm, bank and fuel POIs.
